mapper.select: SELECT id, login_name, display_name, pin_hash, app_role, enabled, created_at, last_login_at FROM app_users WHERE login_name = #{loginName}
SELECT id, login_name, display_name, pin_hash, app_role, enabled, created_at, last_login_at FROM app_users ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, COUNT(DISTINCT completed_at::DATE) AS learning_days, COALESCE(AVG(score), 0)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS average_score, MAX(completed_at) AS last_completed_at FROM quiz_attempts WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT qa.id AS attempt_id, qa.quiz_set_id, qa.passage_id, assignment.study_date AS challenge_date, p.title AS passage_title, qa.attempt_type, qa.score, qa.completed_at FROM quiz_attempts qa JOIN user_quiz_assignments assignment ON assignment.user_id = qa.user_id AND assignment.quiz_set_id = qa.quiz_set_id JOIN passages p ON p.id = qa.passage_id WHERE qa.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY qa.completed_at DESC, qa.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_users ( login_name, display_name, pin_hash, app_role, enabled ) VALUES ( #{loginName}, #{displayName}, #{pinHash}, #{appRole}, #{enabled} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_users WHERE app_role = 'ADMIN' AND enabled = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE app_users SET app_role = 'ADMIN' WHERE login_name = #{loginName} AND enabled = TRUE AND app_role <> 'ADMIN'
